issues.finding: Coverage source concentration uses canonical-action count although repeated axis/gamma variants of the same event have separate canonical actions, while C1 samples uniformly by event signature. Repeating non-dominant-source event variants can turn the <=20% action-share gate from fail to pass without adding any event signatures or responsible sessions, and without reducing the dominant-source probability under C1.
issues.counterexample: A pool with60 unique event signatures/actions,20 from sessionA and40 from other sessions initially fails20/60. Adding40 axis/gamma variants only of those other existing signatures makes20/100 pass, while A still represents20/60 signatures (and can dominate one D/X selected membership). Other predeclared count/type floors can stay unchanged.
issues.concrete_fix: Define source-concentration admission on deduplicated dangerous event signatures, or preferably the actual declared C1 D/X slot/signature/member sampling probabilities (with explicit membership scope); preserve raw action-share as descriptive only. Require that adding repetitions of existing event signatures without new responsible sources cannot rescue coverage admission. Mirror denominator/threshold in basis and add a structural fixture for this invariance.

selected_paragraphs.text: - POST-A62：FIT4183唯一候选、unsafe1806，但原 N-top 危险仅13/980、9/995，原生危险 N-top均0；这些危险动作只占384000 draw的633/405次。R2 N-top AUC在FIT为.9656/.9528，在CAL为.6343/.6667。CAL首个危险q8.94e−8/2.57e−7导致大量安全动作被拒；新确认四cells仍有12/13/15/15个安全JEPA收益 N-top动作。

基准 main HEAD `db0d04c6543813e2bc3d3456d3a6ecdfd09f327e`；A62 source HEAD `dda29a526bd1ac1d9611b7edabd81974a683811d`；A62模型manifest SHA `2421febaf3acbf47e0651fa09058813b7db30f215ba2f709d1aabb58f638e4a4`。执行前用 actual Git 对象与实际文件SHA核basis，不能信嵌入的passed。

每组新建**1500条**mixed，总3000条；每条4–8个不同source clip、片段长度4–80、`gamma090`概率.5、`reuse=True,p_same_next=.35`，调用原A62 recipe构造器。RNG `default_rng([2026110563,63,d])`，d=0/1分别F0/F1。同轴不重复source，所有refs必须落本组；不为危险数调长度/类别/recipe、不追加“更难”的流。先冻全部recipe/source refs/SHA/actualGit，再有任何辅助头输出。变换不改变五类或真边界规则。

**准入全部按去重signature或责任session计；动作数仅作描述。** 对每seed的危险D/X_only分别构造去重集合S_D、S_X；signature的责任session集合必须在全部成员间一致，否则审计失败。C1危险抽样各4个槽，故对任一session s：`p_D(s)=|{e∈S_D:s∈responsible(e)}|/|S_D|`，`p_X(s)`同理，实际危险增强槽的来源参与概率`p_mix(s)=.5*p_D(s)+.5*p_X(s)`。三者的最大值各须≤.20；不能用candidate轴数、gamma复本数或整个流的session数作分母。跨D/X的同一signature在union只计1，两个membership的概率分别如实计算。
| 来源集中度 | max p_D(s)、max p_X(s)、max p_mix(s) 各≤20%，按上述实际signature抽样概率 |
**Pass不是开训充分条件：** 还须用实际spend、空间、全部后续24000步/校准/238行/140paired/56supports/34native/图QA/独立审计/closure预测重新完成全caps准入，并冻结coverage证据、draw、数据与actualGit。

C1选中部分：先在对应membership内均匀抽signature，再在signature内均匀抽canonical动作，可有放回；同一signature全部成员的责任session集合须一致，故§4的p_D/p_X/.5混合概率正是实际来源参与概率。每候选保留全池非零曝光概率；75% batch属于全候选replay。C0的mixed后16也有放回。C1的label平衡/去重层级是采样包的一部分，不能声称“只改变了N-top标志、其他梯度分布完全一致”。
**不重洗已暴露的100个inner source sessions。** 逐pin复用A62 `partition_mapping.private.json`（SHA`2e42c56d376d75d8e064df9e7d00cfd0b8622a2810337b6f3c09a1c1f61332d3`）：
